summary: Setting up a Linear OAuth application is straightforward and can be done directly through the workspace settings. The process involves creating an app entry, configuring redirect URIs, and using the provided client credentials for the OAuth2 flow.

approval.notes: The documentation does not mention a review or approval process for OAuth applications.

steps.title: Create OAuth Application
steps.detail: Navigate to the OAuth2 Application creation page to register your app.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs
steps.detail: Set the redirect callback URLs in the application settings to match your application's endpoint.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Flow
steps.detail: Redirect users to the Linear authorization URL with the required client_id, scope, and redirect_uri parameters.

nuances: It is highly recommended to create a dedicated workspace for managing OAuth applications.
Linear supports PKCE for enhanced security.
You can choose between 'user' actor (actions performed as the user) or 'app' actor (actions performed by the app itself) by using the actor parameter.
agent_can_do: Draft the application name and description.
Store client ID and client secret in environment variables.
Construct the authorization URL with appropriate scopes.
human_must_do: Log in to the Linear workspace.
Create the OAuth application in the settings console.
Copy the generated client ID and client secret.
Authorize the application during the initial testing phase.
